subject: Request: Executive sign-off for 4-year price anchoring + renewal protection (Stratiform)
messages:
From: Eric Tan <eric.tan@stratiform.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Multi-year commercial proposal - price protection request

Alex —

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday. Stratiform is preparing a multi-year procurement recommendation and our CFO has asked for stronger price stability for a 4-year commitment. High level ask:

- 4-year price anchor on the baseline unit price for the committed volume
- annual uplift cap not to exceed 7% year-over-year
- renewal protection on the first renewal so that the renewal increases do not exceed 10% of the prior year effective rate unless both parties agree

We need a commercial term sheet by next week to present to our exec committee. I attached our procurement framework for context (Stratiform_Procurement_RFP_0909.pdf). Can Redwood provide a signoff path for this level of price protection and any exceptions we should expect?

Thanks,
Eric Tan
Head of Procurement, Stratiform Systems
Attachment: Stratiform_Procurement_RFP_0909.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Eric Tan <eric.tan@stratiform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-year commercial proposal - price protection request

Eric —

Appreciate the clear ask and the RFP. We can get you a proposed term sheet today as a starting point. Internal note: copying dealdesk and finance for approval/exec signoff.

Summary of our recommended commercial response (draft term sheet attached):
- Term: 48 months (4 years)
- Anchor: lock baseline committed unit price for the term (applies to committed-volume buckets only)
- Uplift: capped at 6% YoY for years 2–4 (year 1 introductory adjustment 0%); maximum cumulative uplift over term ~18%
- Renewal protection: first renewal guaranteed not to exceed 8% over year 4 effective rate, unless Redwood and Stratiform mutually agree to a larger increase; Redwood reserves the right to apply alternative model-class pricing at renewal if underlying model costs materially change (with 60 days notice)
- Floor: price floor set to not be lower than 5% below current committed effective rate (protects Redwood economics on heavily discounted deals)
- Discount: proposed up-front effective discount of 15% off list in exchange for 4-year committed spend and minimum monthly committed usage (MMC) - see term sheet for tiers
- SLAs & credits: SLA proposed at 99.9% availability with financial credits; legal to confirm wording

Attachments: redwood-stratiform-term-sheet-v1.xlsx (I added comments on the discount tiers and MMC).

Ask to internal recipients: Marissa / Kim / Aditya — this deviates from standard price protection templates (multi-year anchor + low uplift + renewal cap + above-discount). Can I get an executive decision on whether we can offer the above parameters and any required guardrails (SLA, termination fees, audit rights)? If possible please respond today — Stratiform needs something for their exec packet by next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-stratiform-term-sheet-v1.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive sign-off for 4-year price anchoring + renewal protection (Stratiform)

Alex —

Thanks for the draft. High-level comments (attached as inline on the spreadsheet):
- Risk: 4-year lock + 15% initial discount + only 6% cap effectively increases our exposure to model/infra cost inflation. Need a fallback if cloud/GPU costs spike materially.
- Legal / commercial asks: require an SLA credit ladder and explicit audit/data usage clause. Also need a termination for convenience fee schedule (phased) if they terminate early — otherwise we eat too much.
- Discount: agree to consider multi-year discount but prefer 12% max unless we can secure MMC and a non-cancellable minimum spend.
- Renewal protection: happy with a capped renewal increase but want to change "Redwood reserves the right to apply alternative model-class pricing" to a defined exception list (e.g., vendor discontinued model families, force majeure on supply chain).

Please add a minimum monthly committed usage clause (tiered) and a clear SLA remedy before we send externally. I'm attaching my commented term sheet.

Marissa
VP, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
Attachments: alex-commented-term-sheet.xlsx

On 2027-09-12 11:04, Alex Martinez wrote:
> Eric —
> 
> Appreciate the clear ask and the RFP. We can get you a proposed term sheet today as a starting point...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal <legal@redwood.ai>, Finance <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-15T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Executive decision: Conditional approval for Stratiform 4-year anchor

Team —

I reviewed the draft term sheet and Marissa's comments. After discussion with Finance and Legal, Executive grants conditional approval to offer the outlined 4-year anchor to Stratiform under the following binding conditions (these must be in the final contract):

1) Discount capped at 12% effective off list. Any deeper discount requires CFO sign-off.
2) Uplift capped at 6% YoY (years 2–4). No cumulative uplift allowance above the sum of annual caps.
3) Renewal protection: first renewal increase limited to 8% unless both parties sign a change order. Redwood may not unilaterally re-price for renewal except under a narrow, enumerated set of cost pass-through events (explicitly listed in the SOW).
4) Mandatory MMC (minimum monthly committed usage) clause with tiering and non-cancellable yearly minimums; if MMC not met, apply shortfall true-up.
5) SLA 99.9% with an agreed credit ladder and a maximum service credit of 30% of monthly invoice for repeated breaches.
6) Early termination schedule: mutually agreed phased termination fees to protect Redwood's amortized onboarding/discount costs.
7) Audit and compliance clause: Redwood may request proof of contracted usage for monitoring and audit; data sharing limited to usage metrics only.
8) Legal must add a market-disruption carveout allowing limited repricing if third-party model/infra costs increase >20% YoY (with 60-day notice and customer right to negotiate alternative models).

Subject to Legal & Finance codifying these terms, you have approval to proceed and send a redline-capable term sheet to Stratiform. Once they accept, Legal to coordinate DocuSign. I am also CCing Legal and Finance to ensure the final doc reflects these items. Please copy me on the external send.

Kimberly Park
SVP, Commercial & GTM | Redwood Inference
Attachments: exec-approval-conditions-20270915.pdf
